feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Morgan breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Quinn mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Brendan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gus says quietly "We've been walking past those." Haftom says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Quinn has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Theo breathes "Say that again — slower." Gus says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Sari has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jovan mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Nikolai says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gus breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Brendan says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.

"Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Quinn says quietly "And you're still standing." Nikolai breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Brendan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gus says quietly "And you're still standing." Nikolai mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Morgan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Haftom asks "The fire feels smaller now." Nikolai says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Gus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Morgan says quietly "We've been walking past those." Nikolai asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

"The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Haftom asks "Say that again — slower." Morgan mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
